messages:
Nina: Kicking off a short thread to align on the cloud catalog private-offer packaging + joint announcement runway. Need definitive answers for: SKU ids, AMI/VM/container artifacts per cloud, public branding copy vs partner co-brand, and the trial/eula snippet required by marketplaces. Can we lock these by EOD?
Evan: Quick status: AWS ingestion wants AMI ids and seller pricing CSV; Azure needs SIG image gallery references; GCP will accept a container image + product/version. We should publish a single canonical CSV and then add per-cloud mapping doc.
Priya: Proposed SKU format to keep short: rwi.<edition>.<units>.<region>. Example rwi.pro.2.us. Add metadata columns: arch,gpu_support,price_currency,trial_days,artifact_link.
Sam: Artifact note: x86 AMIs live in us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1. arm64 AMIs only in us-east-1 today. For Azure SIG we have version 2 in us & eu galleries. Container digest is gcr.io/redwood/rl:2026-03-22@sha256:deadbeef.
LegalOpsBot: Marketplace legal checklist: trial_days must be <=14; short trial blurb required on offer page; DPA link must be attached for EU regions; export control + sanctions clause included. Suggested blurb: "Try Redwood Inference free for up to 14 days. Cancel during trial to avoid charges. Trial may convert to paid subscription automatically."
Nina: On co-branding: partners asked to include partner logo on the offer page for joint announcement. Marketplace rules vary; Azure allows partner logos in offer metadata, AWS is stricter. We should prepare two variants: partner-logo-allowed and partner-logo-light (text only).
Evan: Ops action: I'll publish a mapping file: canonical_csv -> {aws:ami_list,azure:sig_refs,gcp:container_digest}. Also adding an attribute column 'marketplace_allowed_logo' true/false.
Priya: Uploaded canonical CSV sample: ``sku,display_name,edition,units,region,arch,gpu_support,price_currency,trial_days,artifact_link
rwi.pro.2.us,Redwood Inference Pro - 2 units,pro,2,us-east-1,x86_64,t4|a100,USD,14,https://artifacts.redwood/sku/pro-2-metadata.json``
artifact-bot: Lint results: 2 warnings - missing DPA_attachment for eu SKUs, ambiguous region support for arm AMIs. See /lint/1720055555-report.json
Sam: I'll push arm replication plan to ap-southeast-1 in the next sprint; for now mark arm SKUs region-limited in the CSV.
Nina: Okay team: actions recap: Evan = publish mapping and seller CSV (tomorrow), Priya = finalize CSV template and short copy (today), Sam = attach artifact digests and note region limits (EOD), LegalOpsBot = paste final EULA/trial text + DPA link. We'll hold a 10m sync at 4pm to triage lint warnings. If you can't join, drop files in the checklist and tag me. :rocket:
